title: TCG:Secrets and Seekers
summary: Secrets and Seekers is the first card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game and is of the same name as the animated series. The set focuses on story elements from the first seventeen episodes of Season 1 as well as setting the precedent for introducing a variety of new characters and Titans exclusive to the card game. In addition to the booster packs, a Starter Deck for the set was released, which contained several exclusive cards, a mission map, training manual and bonus DVD containing the Huntik TCG Tutorial.

full_text:
Secrets and Seekers is the first card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game and is of the same name as the animated series. The set focuses on story elements from the first seventeen episodes of Season 1 as well as setting the precedent for introducing a variety of new characters and Titans exclusive to the card game. In addition to the booster packs, a Starter Deck for the set was released, which contained several exclusive cards, a mission map, training manual and bonus DVD containing the Huntik TCG Tutorial.

}}'''Secrets and Seekers''' is the first card set of the [[Huntik Trading Card Game]] and is of the same name as the [[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers|animated series]]. The set focuses on story elements from the first seventeen episodes of [[Season 1]] as well as setting the precedent for introducing a variety of new characters and Titans exclusive to the card game. In addition to the booster packs, a [[TCG:Starter Deck|Starter Deck]] for the set was released, which contained several exclusive cards, a mission map, training manual and bonus DVD containing the [[Huntik TCG Tutorial]].
